name: mteb2026
description: MTEB(eng, classic) 56-task matrix rebuilt from a pinned post-snapshot state of the MTEB results, with every model that has >= 2 of the 56 tasks. Rows flagged in_snapshot are the models of data/mteb.matrix.npz; the others are candidates for a prospective (temporal) test set.
row_order: model names sorted by Unicode code point (Python sorted), as in mteb.matrix.npz

score_definition.value: mteb TaskResult.get_score() after validate_and_filter_scores(task) with the MTEB(eng, classic) task objects: mean of main_score over eval_splits x hf_subsets (one entry per task here); missing split/subset -> missing cell; native 0-1 scale.
score_definition.revision_merge: per cell, first available value over result revisions ordered by (has model_meta.json desc, #complete tasks desc, revision asc); snapshot used pivot_table(aggfunc='first') in filesystem order
score_definition.model_inclusion: >= 2 observed of the 56 tasks; models without model_meta.json in the results repo are included (snapshot required it) and flagged via has_model_meta_json
score_definition.same_as: data/download_mteb.py (mteb.load_results + TaskResult.get_score) + data/build_matrices.py (drop models with <= 1 task)

release_date_rule: release_date = mteb package ModelMeta.release_date if the model name is in the mteb==2.18.7 registry; else release_date from the results repo model_meta.json (a serialized ModelMeta) at the pinned HEAD; else the UTC date of the first results-repo commit adding any file of the model (left-censored at the repo's first commit, 2024-07); else null.

status_values.in_snapshot_renamed: row of data/mteb.matrix.npz whose results were later moved to a new model name (snapshot_name gives the old name); in_snapshot is True
status_values.snapshot_raw_dropped_le1_task: in data/mteb.npz but dropped by build_matrices.py (<= 1 task then)
status_values.added_after_snapshot: no 56-task result in the results repo at the snapshot commit 37dfa3b5
status_values.pre_snapshot_excluded_no_model_meta_json: had 56-task results at the snapshot commit only in revision dirs without model_meta.json (mteb.load_results(require_model_meta=True) skipped them)
status_values.pre_snapshot_other: had 56-task results at the snapshot commit under this name but was not in the snapshot for another reason

duplicate_rule: duplicate_of_snapshot_model = a row of data/mteb.matrix.npz (snapshot name) such that >= 3 and >= 50% of this model's task result files are byte-identical (same git blob oid) to that row's files at the snapshot commit or at HEAD, or such that the two rows have equal values on >= 50% of >= 3 common cells; evaluated for rows not in_snapshot

prospective_test_set.rule: status == 'added_after_snapshot' and duplicate_of_snapshot_model is null (per-model field recommended_prospective)
prospective_test_set.why: status is defined from the git history of the results repo (no 56-task result at the snapshot commit 37dfa3b5), which is reliable; release_date is author-supplied and sometimes later than the first appearance of the results (release_date_after_first_seen) or much earlier than the snapshot. Duplicates re-use the result files of snapshot rows and would leak training rows.

scores_hf_mteb_results.evidence: license field of the dataset card YAML front matter (hf_mteb_results/README.md, sha256 c7ab3f030120876270b811609538a69bcb973034b39636e0079c06df2baf4974)

E_near_identical_row_pairs.note: pairs with one row outside the snapshot are flagged per model (duplicate_of_snapshot_model); pairs of two snapshot rows already exist in data/mteb.matrix.npz and are reported only

caveats: Use prospective_test_set (status added_after_snapshot, duplicates removed) for temporal evaluation; in_snapshot=False also contains 11 old models (no model_meta.json / dropped with <= 1 task).

Duplicates of snapshot rows (excluded from prospective_test_set): jinaai/jina-embeddings-v5-omni-nano re-uses the result files of jinaai/jina-embeddings-v5-text-nano; jinaai/jina-embeddings-v5-omni-small re-uses the result files of jinaai/jina-embeddings-v5-text-small.

release_date is taken as published and is not a reliable temporal filter on its own: 6 rows have release_date later than the first appearance of their results in the results repo (release_date_after_first_seen), and 21 added_after_snapshot models have release_date <= 2026-03-14.
17 snapshot models now appear under new names (status in_snapshot_renamed): join with data/mteb.matrix.npz via snapshot_name.

Snapshot rows carry the current upstream values: see consistency_checks.D for the 16 changed cells (8 models), 3 lost and 130 added cells; all other common cells agree to 1.1e-16 (data/mteb.matrix.npz went through a CSV round trip).
